text: Every man's reason is, and must be, his guide; and I may as well expect that every man should be of my size and complexion, as that he should reason just as I do. Every man seeks for truth; but God only knows who has found it.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter XIV, to his son, London, September 21, Old Style 1747
